# World Zero — migrated schema snapshot. GENERATED FILE; do not hand-edit.
#
# Regenerate with:  python scripts/dump_schema_snapshot.py   (from backend/)
#
# This file is a SECOND SOURCE for tests/integration/test_migrations_match_models.py.
# It is the only description of the schema in this repo that is not derived from
# models/ at runtime: 0002_squashed builds its tables with
# Base.metadata.create_all, so a freshly migrated database is the ORM's schema by
# construction and `alembic check` ends up comparing the models to themselves
# (#2448). A committed file cannot do that — it changes only when a human commits
# it, which is the entire point of it.
#
# THEREFORE: regenerating this file to clear a red test defeats the check. It is
# the same move as raising a coverage floor instead of writing the test. When the
# test goes red, READ its diff first and confirm every line is a change you
# intended and that a migration carries it forward on an already-deployed
# database. Only then regenerate and commit, in the same PR as the migration.
#
# Columns are sorted by name, not by ordinal position, so that adding one moves a
# single line. Constraint and index definitions are Postgres's own canonical text
# (pg_get_constraintdef / pg_get_indexdef) — which is why docker-compose and CI
# have to stay on the same Postgres major version: a bump can reword lines here
# that no migration touched. That is still a diff to read, not one to skip.

enum accountstatus = active, suspended, deleted
enum characterstatus = active, banned
enum duelstatus = pending, active, settled, declined, resolved
enum factionstatus = visible, hidden, retired
enum mediatype = image, video, audio
enum moderationstatus = visible, flagged, hidden, failed, deleted
enum praxisinvitestatus = pending, accepted, declined
enum praxisstatus = in_progress, pending, submitted
enum praxistype = solo, collab, duel
enum relationshipstatus = active, blocked
enum relationshiptype = friend, foe
enum taskstatus = pending, active, retired
enum tasktype = standard, metatask
enum taunttriggertype = score_overtake, level_up, praxis_complete

table account
  column active_character_id bigint
  column albescent_glimpsed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column albescent_revealed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column albescent_unlocked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column email character varying NOT NULL
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column status accountstatus NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint fk_account_active_character FOREIGN KEY (active_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)
  constraint pk_account PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_account_email UNIQUE (email)

table account_role
  column account_id bigint NOT NULL
  column granted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column granted_by bigint NOT NULL
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column role_id bigint NOT NULL
  constraint fk_account_role_account_id_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id)
  constraint fk_account_role_granted_by_account FOREIGN KEY (granted_by) REFERENCES account(id)
  constraint fk_account_role_role_id_role FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES role(id)
  constraint pk_account_role PRIMARY KEY (id)

table account_tombstone
  column account_id bigint NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column provider character varying NOT NULL
  column provider_user_hash character varying NOT NULL
  constraint fk_account_tombstone_account_id_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id)
  constraint pk_account_tombstone PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_account_tombstone_provider_provider_user_hash UNIQUE (provider, provider_user_hash)

table alembic_version
  column version_num character varying(32) NOT NULL
  constraint alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)

table character
  column account_id bigint NOT NULL
  column avatar_url character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column bio text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column departed_at timestamp with time zone
  column display_name character varying NOT NULL
  column faction_slug character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'na'::character varying
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column location character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column status characterstatus NOT NULL
  column tagline text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column username character varying NOT NULL
  constraint fk_character_account_id_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id)
  constraint fk_character_faction_slug_faction FOREIGN KEY (faction_slug) REFERENCES faction(slug)
  constraint pk_character PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_character_username UNIQUE (username)
  index ix_character_account_id CREATE INDEX ix_character_account_id ON public."character" USING btree (account_id)

table character_block
  column blocked_character_id bigint NOT NULL
  column blocker_character_id bigint NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  constraint ck_character_block_no_self_block CHECK ((blocker_character_id <> blocked_character_id))
  constraint fk_character_block_blocked_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (blocked_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint fk_character_block_blocker_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (blocker_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint pk_character_block PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_character_block_blocker_character_id_blocked_character_id UNIQUE (blocker_character_id, blocked_character_id)

table character_stats
  column all_time_score integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column character_id bigint NOT NULL
  column era_id bigint NOT NULL
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column level integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column level_jump_used_at_level integer
  column score integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column votes_spent_this_era integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  constraint fk_character_stats_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)
  constraint fk_character_stats_era_id_era FOREIGN KEY (era_id) REFERENCES era(id)
  constraint pk_character_stats PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_character_stats_character_id_era_id UNIQUE (character_id, era_id)

table comment
  column body_text text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column created_by_id bigint NOT NULL
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column is_edited boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column is_withdrawn boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column moderation_status moderationstatus NOT NULL DEFAULT 'visible'::moderationstatus
  column praxis_id bigint
  column task_id bigint
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint ck_comment_one_target CHECK ((num_nonnulls(praxis_id, task_id) = 1))
  constraint fk_comment_created_by_id_character FOREIGN KEY (created_by_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)
  constraint fk_comment_praxis_id_praxis FOREIGN KEY (praxis_id) REFERENCES praxis(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint fk_comment_task_id_task FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES task(id)
  constraint pk_comment PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index ix_comment_praxis_id CREATE INDEX ix_comment_praxis_id ON public.comment USING btree (praxis_id)
  index ix_comment_task_id CREATE INDEX ix_comment_task_id ON public.comment USING btree (task_id)

  index ix_praxis_created_by_id CREATE INDEX ix_praxis_created_by_id ON public.praxis USING btree (created_by_id)

  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column status relationshipstatus NOT NULL
  column to_character_id bigint NOT NULL
  column type relationshiptype NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint fk_relationship_from_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (from_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)
  constraint fk_relationship_to_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (to_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)

  constraint uq_relationship_from_character_id_to_character_id UNIQUE (from_character_id, to_character_id)

table role
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column description character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column name character varying NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint pk_role PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint uq_role_name UNIQUE (name)

table task
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column created_by bigint NOT NULL
  column description text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column is_task_vision_eligible boolean NOT NULL
  column level_required integer NOT NULL
  column metatask_faction_slug character varying
  column notes text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column point_value integer NOT NULL
  column primary_faction_slug character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'na'::character varying
  column status taskstatus NOT NULL
  column task_type tasktype NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard'::tasktype
  column title character varying NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint fk_task_created_by_character FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "character"(id)
  constraint fk_task_metatask_faction_slug_faction FOREIGN KEY (metatask_faction_slug) REFERENCES faction(slug)
  constraint fk_task_primary_faction_slug_faction FOREIGN KEY (primary_faction_slug) REFERENCES faction(slug)
  constraint pk_task PRIMARY KEY (id)

table vote
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
  column praxis_id bigint NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column value integer NOT NULL
  column voter_account_id bigint NOT NULL
  column voter_character_id bigint NOT NULL
  constraint fk_vote_praxis_id_praxis FOREIGN KEY (praxis_id) REFERENCES praxis(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint fk_vote_voter_account_id_account FOREIGN KEY (voter_account_id) REFERENCES account(id)
  constraint fk_vote_voter_character_id_character FOREIGN KEY (voter_character_id) REFERENCES "character"(id)

  constraint uq_vote_praxis_account UNIQUE (praxis_id, voter_account_id)
